# Glendora Mercedes & BMW Service

Glendora Mercedes & BMW Service is a family-owned auto repair shop in Covina, California.
We service and repair BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Mini Cooper, and Smart cars.
Our shop is at 1459 N Ranger Drive, Unit 4, Covina, CA 91722.
Ask for Phillip, the owner.
Our hours are Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm.
Our phone number is (626) 331-8552.
Our email is glendoramercedes@yahoo.com, answered any hour.
We do factory-scheduled maintenance, brakes and suspension, engine and transmission repair, and electrical and computer diagnostics.
We use OEM or high-quality aftermarket parts, your choice, and honor extended service contracts.
Drivers come to us from Covina and Glendora.
